meta.tagline: Si Marites, pero tama ang info.
meta.defaultTitle: Marites PH: step-by-step help for Philippine government paperwork
meta.defaultDescription: Personalized, verified, step-by-step instructions for Philippine IDs, registrations, and permits. Not affiliated with any government agency.

brand.promise: All the chika you need, but accurate.

home.intro: Step-by-step instructions for Philippine IDs, registrations, and permits, checked against official sources.
home.pillarVerifiedBody: Requirements, fees, and office details come only from official sources. Each one shows its source link and the date we last checked it.
home.pillarPlanTitle: A plan that fits your schedule
home.pillarPlanBody: Tell us what you already have and when you're free. We'll suggest which ID or registration to do first and which office to go to.
home.pillarCommunityBody: Tips and stories from other people, always labeled as community experience and never mixed with official requirements.
home.statusBody: We're verifying our first guides (passport, national ID, NBI clearance, postal ID). They'll appear here once each requirement is checked against its official source.
home.sampleStampCaption: Every guide carries this mark, with the date we last checked it and a link to the official source.

freelancer.title: Marites Freelancer
freelancer.intro: Track your income and expenses, compare the 8% option with graduated rates, and never miss a BIR deadline.
freelancer.preview: Marites Freelancer is a paid plan. Your data stays private to your account.
freelancer.disclaimer: Guidance and computation help only, not professional tax advice. Marites PH doesn't file returns or issue invoices for you; use BIR's official systems. For complex situations, consult a licensed CPA.
freelancer.cpaUnreviewed: Some tax rules used here haven't been reviewed by a CPA yet. Treat the numbers as estimates.
freelancer.noRules: Tax rules for this year haven't been published yet (they need a CPA's review first). The tracker still works.

negosyo.title: Marites Negosyo
negosyo.intro: Your businesses in one place: permit renewals, employee contributions, and remittance deadlines.
negosyo.upgrade: Marites Negosyo is a paid plan for small business owners. It also includes Marites Freelancer.
negosyo.signIn: Sign in to use Marites Negosyo. Your business and payroll data are private to your account.
negosyo.disclaimer: Guidance and computation help only, not professional advice. Marites PH doesn't remit contributions or file for you; use each agency's official system. Confirm amounts with the agency or a CPA.
